text:
alex: Hey, anyone else seeing the latency sparkline in /console -> endpoints where the 'avg' line overlaps our p95 shading? Screenshot: https://redwood.internal/s/abc123
marta: yup noticed it this morning. looks like mean is being rendered instead of median? dashboard docs said p50/p95/p99 only
ryan: tricky — the sparkline datapoints come from the ingestion summary which currently emits mean + tdigest quantiles. maybe we accidentally swapped the series mapping in the dashboard config
alex: steps to repro: open endpoint /v1/text, set timespan 1h, compare 'cohort: all' vs 'cohort: cached' — mean stays similar but p95 jumps
sam: can you paste the panel config? I can check the mapping
alex: 
```json
series: ["summary.mean_ms","quantiles.p50_ms","quantiles.p95_ms","quantiles.p99_ms"]
plot: {lines: [0], area: true}
``` 
marta: aha — the panel expects series order mean, median, p95, p99 but our ingestion started shipping 'median' as summary.mean_ms due to a naming change in the rollout. the panel then labels them p50/p95 but plots the wrong series
ryan: PR incoming to fix ingestion naming. Also suggest adding explicit series IDs in the panel instead of positional mapping. I'll open a quick patch
sam: would be great to add a tooltip on hover that shows 'source: summary vs tdigest' so product folks know provenance
alex: +1. this caused confusion in support ticket #4321 — customer saw p95 spike but we were actually seeing mean drift
marta: linked issue: https://github.com/redwood/repo/issues/789
deploy-bot: deployment started for bundle 2024-09-12T08:00Z by @ryan
ryan: PATCH: https://github.com/redwood/repo/pull/824 — renames ingestion keys to quantiles.mean_ms -> summary.mean_ms and updates panel to use explicit ids
sam: can we also add a small unit test that renders panels with synthetic series names to avoid silent mapping regressions? small python test should do
alex: agreed. also can we add a console note for operators: when changing telemetry series names, update dashboard reference mapping
marta: creating follow-up doc in docs/console/telemetry-migration.md
ryan: rolling the fix to staging now, will monitor p95 vs mean alignment, will update thread
alex: thanks all :rocket:
ryan: staging looks clean, p95 now decoupled from mean on sparkline. keeping an eye for a bit
marta: closing the support ticket with explanation. good catch
alex: resolved, moving to done
